title: Patient Payment Plans Schedule of Deductible-Exposure Shares for Add-On Charges
content:
An add-on charge on an active Patient Payment Plans plan carries a deductible-exposure share set by the remaining deductible recorded on the patient's Patient Financial Account.

| Remaining deductible on the Patient Financial Account | Deductible-exposure share |
|---|---|
| 1,000.00 (1000.00) or more | 0.96 |
| Above 0.00 and below 1,000.00 | 0.985 |
| 0.00 | 1 |

**Schedule rule.** The deductible-exposure share of the add-on is 0.96 when the financial account's remaining deductible is at least 1,000.00, 0.985 when it is above 0.00 but below 1,000.00, and 1 when it is 0.00. The share multiplies the counted amount of the add-on, without intermediate rounding.

**Record read.** The remaining individual deductible of the recorded coverage, as the Patient Financial Account shows it.

**Boundaries (hypothetical).** A remaining deductible of exactly 1,000.00 gives 0.96; 999.99 gives 0.985; 0.01 gives 0.985; 0.00 gives 1.

**Figure (hypothetical).** A counted amount of 400.00 on an account with a remaining deductible of 1,250.00: 400.00 multiplied by 0.96 is 384.00.
